evals.name: blocking-with-file-line
evals.prompt: Review PR #220: the new fsd-trash guard accepts an ancestor of the repository.
evals.expected_output: Runs `fsd-review start 220`, reads the diff, and publishes `changes` with a Blocking line that names `file:line`, the problem and the fix, plus the `revisao` delivery with verdict `changes`. Does NOT approve with a Blocking point open.

evals.name: new-commit-refused
evals.prompt: You started the review of #220; Stuart pushed a new commit before you published.
evals.expected_output: The post is refused ("commit novo"); runs `fsd-review start 220` again and reviews the new head. Never publishes a review of an old commit.

evals.name: answers-technical-doubt
evals.prompt: A message from Stuart: "does the trash guard live in fsd-lib or in fsd-trash?"
evals.expected_output: Answers Stuart directly with `fsd-diga stuart` and the reason (a pure helper in fsd-lib, as the handoff said). Does NOT open an issue or a PR comment for it and does NOT send the question to the author.
